name: stance
description: Session modes that are enforced, not requested: investigate, draft, build, ship. Denies the tool calls a stance rules out, auto-switches on phrases like "no code", and shows an 8-bit class badge above the prompt.

autoDetect.title: Auto-detect stance
autoDetect.description: Switch stance when a prompt says things like "no code", "findings only" or "draft only".

showBuild.title: Show band in build
showBuild.description: Show the stance band above the prompt in the default build stance too.
